snippet.title: May 20th Morning Devotional, Serving Other Churches
snippet.description:
We are excited to have our week of prayer and fasting. Today (May 20th) is day 5 of our week and we are looking at Philippians 4:10-23 . Seth Hein our Lake location pastor will be encouraging us. Subscribe to get updates every morning this week!

We will have live streamed prayer meetings Monday-Friday at 6pm and Saturday at 9am.

For more information and resources go to jubileestl.org/fasting.
